checks.text: The page shows the heading "Org Chart" and the text "No roles yet".
Typing "CEO" in the field labelled "Role name" and clicking the button "Add role" adds a list item containing "CEO" and the text "No roles yet" is gone.
With "CEO" present, typing "CTO" in the field labelled "Role name", choosing "CEO" in the select labelled "Reports to", and clicking "Add role" adds a list item containing "CTO" indented under "CEO".
With "CEO" and "CTO" present, clicking the button labelled "Delete CTO" removes the "CTO" item and the list shows only "CEO".
With "CEO" and "CTO" present, clicking the button "Export JSON" copies the text `{"name":"CEO","children":[{"name":"CTO","children":[]}]}` to the clipboard.
With "CEO" and "CTO" present, clicking the tab labelled "Outline" shows a nested list where "CTO" is indented under "CEO"; clicking the tab labelled "Canvas" returns to the tree view.
With "CEO" and "CTO" present, clicking the button labelled "Zoom in" changes the zoom indicator from "100%" to "125%".
With "CEO" and "CTO" present, clicking the button labelled "Auto layout" does not change the list order; "CEO" remains the first item and "CTO" remains the second item.
Reload keeps the roles: after adding "CEO" and "CTO" (CTO reports to CEO), reloading the page still shows the list items "CEO" and "CTO" with "CTO" indented under "CEO".
